linkedin.title: Personalised news is usually just a filter bubble, but it does not have to be.
linkedin.body:
Most news apps approach personalisation by feeding you more of what you already like. It is an easy way to keep people clicking, but it ignores the core purpose of journalism. True information should challenge your perspective, not just confirm it.

At Headlinne, our roadmap is focused on a different kind of customisation. We want to build tools that help you understand the context behind the headlines instead of just showing you more of the same. It is about giving you the full picture, not just the angle you are most comfortable with.

We believe technology should act as a bridge to better understanding. The goal is to strip away the noise and the repetitive feeds so you can actually digest the news that matters to your life. We are moving toward a future where AI helps you become more informed, not just more entertained.
linkedin.cta: If you are curious about how we are rethinking the daily news cycle, you can see what we are building at HEADLINNE.com.

steps.text: This is part of their Hybrid Intelligence push. It relies on a mix of local and cloud processing.

story_card.caption:
